MktCalcInsightObjectDef.description: This score indicates how closely this person matches the characteristics of the ideal customer for your business.
MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT SUM(uiScoringQuery.Fit_Score__c) AS Fit_Score__c, SUM(uiScoringQuery.Unnorm_Fit_Score__c) AS Raw_Fit_Score__c, FIRST(uiScoringQuery.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule2_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule3_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule4_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule5_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule6_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule7_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule8_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule9_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule10_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule11_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule12_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule13_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule14_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule15_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule16_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule17_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule18_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule19_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule20_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule21_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule22_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule23_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule24_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule25_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule26_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule27_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule28_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule29_Score__c,SUM(0) AS Rule30_Score__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm FULL JOIN ( SELECT nonnormalizedQuery.Unified_Individual__c as Unified_Individual__c, FIRST(nonnormalizedQuery.Fit_Score__c) as Unnorm_Fit_Score__c, FIRST(nonnormalizedQuery.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c, CASE WHEN SUM(Totals.num__c) = 1 THEN SUM(100) ELSE ROUND( 100 * ((dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM( nonnormalizedQuery.Fit_Score__c ) )) - 1) / SUM(Totals.num__c - 1), 0 ) END AS Fit_Score__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm FULL JOIN ( SELECT UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c, FIRST(Subquery1Score.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c, (FIRST(Subquery1Score.Rule1_Score__c)) as Fit_Score__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ( ( ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__CountryId__c = 'United States')) THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) as Rule1_Score__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c as Unified_Individual__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm INNER JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c INNER JOIN ssot__Individual__dlm ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c FULL JOIN ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm ON ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c GROUP BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS Subquery1Score ON Subquery1Score.Unified_Individual__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS nonnormalizedQuery ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = nonnormalizedQuery.Unified_Individual__c FULL JOIN ( SELECT COUNT( Distinct_Subquery.Fit_Score__c ) as num__c FROM ( SELECT nonnormalizedQuery.Fit_Score__c as Fit_Score__c FROM (SELECT UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Unified_Individual__c, FIRST(Subquery1Score.Rule1_Score__c) AS Rule1_Score__c, (FIRST(Subquery1Score.Rule1_Score__c)) as Fit_Score__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUM(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ( ( ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__CountryId__c = 'United States')) THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) as Rule1_Score__c, UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c as Unified_Individual__c FROM UnifiedIndividual__dlm INNER JOIN IndividualIdentityLink__dlm ON UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c INNER JOIN ssot__Individual__dlm ON IndividualIdentityLink__dlm.SourceRecordId__c = ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c FULL JOIN ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm ON ssot__Individual__dlm.ssot__Id__c = ssot__ContactPointAddress__dlm.ssot__PartyId__c GROUP BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c ) AS Subquery1Score ON Subquery1Score.Unified_Individual__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c) AS nonnormalizedQuery GROUP BY nonnormalizedQuery.Fit_Score__c ) AS Distinct_Subquery ) AS Totals ON nonnormalizedQuery.Unified_Individual__c <> '' and Totals.num__c <> -10000 GROUP BY nonnormalizedQuery.Unified_Individual__c )as uiScoringQuery ON uiScoringQuery.Unified_Individual__c = UnifiedIndividual__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY Unified_Individual__c
